name: @sfdxy/mule-lint
description: Static analysis tool for MuleSoft applications - supports humans, AI agents, and CI/CD pipelines
author: Avinava

scripts.lint: npm run lint:source && npm run lint:app && npm run lint:tests
scripts.lint:source: eslint src/api-contract src/catalog src/core src/engine src/rules src/types src/quality --max-warnings=0
scripts.lint:app: eslint src/formatter src/formatters src/mcp bin commitlint.config.ts vitest.config.mts --max-warnings=0
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src/catalog src/core src/engine src/rules src/types src/quality --fix && eslint src/formatter src/formatters src/mcp bin commitlint.config.ts vitest.config.mts --fix && eslint tests --fix
scripts.package:check: npm run build && publint && node scripts/package-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run lint:unused && npm run test:coverage && npm run package:check && npm run audit:prod
scripts.release: git tag v$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version') && git push origin v$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')
